rationale: The agent effectively authenticated the user using their full name and zip code, identified the correct order, and understood the user’s request to change the luggage set to a coat. Upon finding that the preferred coat was unavailable, the agent promptly offered the user the option to cancel the order instead. The user confirmed the cancellation request, which the agent processed correctly and provided appropriate information about the refund. All actions were in line with the stated policy, leading to a successful resolution.
